name: Desperate Spark
effect: Kessa's base ATK +200%.
flavour: A final surge, when there is no other choice.

name: Storm's Fury
effect: Kessa's Arc Burst deals +30% damage while your fortress is below 30% health.
flavour: The closer the walls fall, the louder the sky.

name: Iron Vanguard
effect: All your Infantry heroes gain +10% base ATK.
flavour: First through the breach, last to fall back.

name: Shield Brothers
effect: All your Infantry heroes gain +15% max health.

name: Thundering Hooves
effect: All your Ranged heroes gain +15% base ATK.
flavour: Spear, shot and arrow - one volley.

name: Quick Study
effect: Skill cooldowns recharge 5% faster.

name: Second Wind
effect: While your fortress is below 90% health, skills recharge a further 5% faster.
flavour: Knocked down is not knocked out.

name: Overclock
effect: If your skill cooldown bonus is over 25%, your heroes deal +25% damage.

name: Lone Wolf
effect: +200% ATK. Each hero after the first cuts this bonus by 90%.
flavour: An army is just a crowd waiting to scatter.

name: Hardy Stock
effect: All your heroes and summons gain +5% max health.
flavour: Built to last, every one of them.

name: Last Bastion
effect: Once per fight, when your fortress drops below 10% health, it takes no damage for 2 seconds.

name: Polar Flux
effect: Once per fight, below 50% health: a blast hits EVERYONE on the field for 30% of their max health.

name: Twin Citadels
effect: If both players use a Fortress I, your fortress takes 30% less damage.

name: Keen Edge
effect: Fortress super bursts deal +10% damage.
flavour: Sharpen the shot, not the blade.

name: Cannon Doctrine
effect: While your fortress is a Fortress I, your whole side deals +70% damage.

name: Critical Mass
effect: Fortress cannon damage x10 from its first burst, multiplying again with every burst after.
flavour: It only gets worse from here.

name: Regen
effect: Your fortress heals 10% of its max health every 5 seconds.

name: Drop Signal
effect: Each time your Railgun fires, fallen summons are redeployed and switched-off drones come back online.

name: Death Gerbils
effect: Every 5 seconds, summon a Death Gerbil.

name: Boss Slayer
effect: +30% damage to bosses (Conquest chapter bosses and the Boss Rush kaiju).
